title: Set up your shop in a minute
intro: Welcome to Shopinbos. In one minute, you'll set up your online shop with Rex, your AI shop builder.

steps.caption: Tap Start now
steps.vo: When you open Shopinbos for the first time, Rex says hello. Tap Start now.

steps.caption: Tell Rex what you sell
steps.vo: Pick your language, then tell Rex what you sell, in your own words. Then choose where you're starting from. For example, I have products.

steps.caption: Pick your brand
steps.vo: Rex makes a brand for you: a shop name, colours and a look. Change anything you like, then tap Looks good.

steps.caption: Add your first products
steps.vo: Add your first products. Snap photos and Rex writes the names, prices and descriptions. One product is enough to go live.

steps.caption: Choose how you get paid
steps.vo: Choose how customers can pay you, like bank transfer, card, or pay on delivery. Then tap Put my shop live.

steps.caption: Share your shop
steps.vo: Your shop is open! Tap Share on WhatsApp to put it on your status, where your customers are.

outro: That's it. Your shop is live, and you can change anything later from My shop.
